reason: Nokia Network as Code integration in this repo needs a specific gateway host header, a redirect-based number verification flow whose redirect_uri must match between start and finish, and the v2 verify call. These rules were only found by probing and fixing, so a future session needs them up front.

Episode probed Nokia sandbox location.verify: answers are fixed per test number and ignore the area; real numbers 404. The project skill has no location facts, and a future session would otherwise claim live location works from sandbox results.

Episode probed the Nokia simulator and found the 7-day SIM-swap rule cannot pass for any simulator number that also passes Number Verification, so production needed a configurable window. The skill's Nokia facts were incomplete (only Location was documented) and the probe technique was not recorded. Also records the user's choice to keep checks real rather than mock one of them.
The Nokia switch is a global NETWORK_MODE=nokia with per-check overrides, not a per-API NETWORK_MODE_<API> switch as this line says; the NEXT_PUBLIC build-time pitfall is new.

Live limits discovered by probing the simulator with the production callback: real SIMs get 402/404, and a sandbox location pass ignores the area. Future sessions must not promise a live real-SIM demo.
The location radius lesson is about this skill's Location Verification area, but the description never names LOCATION_RADIUS_M, so a future radius change would not route here.
